digest.component_or_area: LLM completion recovery / gate error diagnostic
propositions: Step-budget exhaustion computes a repetition diagnostic via failure_usage but discards it before the gate_error_v1 sidecar is emitted, leaving operators unable to distinguish looping from budget exhaustion

The _bounded_diagnostic filter in completion_recovery.py strips repetition summary keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and rejects list-valued fields, preventing diagnostic survival through the recovery-exception and primary-exception merge chains

The operator-facing close-gate failure message lacks concrete repetition counts (distinct vs total tool calls), requiring operators to read logs instead of reading the error message to diagnose whether budget exhaustion was caused by looping or actual resource limits

Budget exhaustions never reach CompletionAgentStep._recover where failure_diagnostic would be set, so raise_completion_workflow_failure never emits the sidecar (dependency: rebar:fd84-92b4-01ba-4911 establishes reachability)
